_notes: Blackglass Spear: the rift the spear leaves along its flight. One painted still (blackglass_spear_rift.png, 1536x1024): a single horizontal tear of dark glass with a violet glow and shards, on a #00FF00 green screen. Keyed on hue (keyed: "green") so the void stays opaque, then cropped to its own ink. Already horizontal, so no turn. The layer stretches it across the flight line, so its aspect is the shape the art is drawn at.
